overview.text: Victor Preciado is the District 2 councilmember on the Pomona City Council, elected in November 2018. He serves on the Foothill Transit board. He also sits on several water master boards. His campaign says he revitalized every park in District 2, opened a large playground and skate park, and that the city secured a $500,000 grant for Palm Lakes Golf Course. His campaign says he helped deliver groceries to more than 700 families each week during the COVID-19 pandemic. He wants to continue transportation and infrastructure improvements, expand affordable and inclusionary housing, and support youth programs.
